Forge

High-Fidelity Music Player

Visit Lokesh’s portfolio ↗

One person built this. His name is Lokesh.

Forge isn’t a company product with a team behind it. Lokesh designed it, coded it, tested it and shipped every build himself, for Android, Mac and Windows.

It took hard work and far more time than anyone sees: long hours, rewrites, and small details fixed because they bothered him. Forge exists because he wanted a music player that respects the listener, and he cared enough to build it properly.

The tools: Dart and Flutter for the app, C++ and libmpv for the audio engine, Swift for the Mac build, JavaScript, HTML and CSS for the download page, Python for testing and checks, and automated pipelines that package every release.

The download page detects your system and shows a checksum for every file. Forge is built independently and unsigned, so Mac may ask you to right-click and choose Open the first time, and Windows may show an Unknown Publisher notice: choose More info, then Run anyway.
